section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1977
title: 30 ## Distribution of Suicides According to Age: The statistics of suicides by age revealed that the maximum suicides were committed by persons belonging to the age group 18 to 30 years (43.7% of the total suicide cases reported) and the minimum (11.6% of the total suicide cases reported) were committed by the persons of above 50 years of age. Persons committing suicide below 18 years of age accounted for 16.0 per cent of the total and the persons belonging to the age group 30 to 50 years accounted for 28.7 per cent of the total suicide cases reported during 1977. The age-wise pattern of suicides during 1977 was almost the same for States, Union Territories and for India as a whole. Almost the same pattern was noticed during 1976. The detailed statistics are set forth in Table-6.
